errors.error_description: Used a blocking assignment to valid_reg inside a sequential always_ff block that otherwise uses non-blocking assignments, introducing a race condition.
Declared logic unused_flag but never used it anywhere, creating an unused signal.
In the combinational block mapping next_onehot to next_code, omitted a default assignment and any default case, inferring a latch for next_code when no case item matches.
Implemented a deeply nested chain of if-else statements for the encoder priority decision on in_vec, creating long combinational paths and poor synthesis quality.
